outcomes: Students will learn about the aesthetics of film and media and be able to apply that knowledge to productions.
Students will be able to gain experience using various editorial and color techniques and styles to effectively tell a story.
Students will be able to successfully accomplish the tasks of all positions on the editing and color grading team

Students will be able to have the ability to build a reel (digital resume) with their own footage in order to better position themselves for transfer and/or gainful employment in the entertainment industry.
